There are four open research grants at Deccan Valley University of Technology (DVUT) with a deadline in January 2027 [SQL]. Applications are accepted only while a grant's status is open [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].

Here are the open grants with a January 2027 deadline:

| Grant Code | Title | Application Deadline |
|---|---|---|
| GR-ML-02 | Undergraduate Machine Learning Research Assistantship [SQL] | 10 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-IOT-07 | Smart Campus IoT Research Grant [SQL] | 20 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-CY-03 | Cybersecurity Research Scholarship [SQL] | 31 Jan 2027 [SQL] |
| GR-5G-15 | 5G and Next-Gen Networks Fellowship [SQL] | 31 Jan 2027 [SQL] |

Applicants must apply before the deadline shown in the Grants Register, as late applications are not considered [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026-27 §2].
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, application_deadline FROM grants WHERE status = 'open' AND application_deadline BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-01-31' ORDER BY application_deadline LIMIT 50
